notes.title: The Steam Next Fest is ending with a developer Q&A!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35537578/4d5ab2a86b4ccdce7ae7da2a5792bff0298bd550.png[/img]

Thank you, thank you, thank you! This edition of the Steam Next Fest is absolutely smashing! Playing the TOGETHER demo and streaming it for you guys is a blast, so now we cannot wait for the full game release!

Tonight, for the final day, we are running a Q&A video with the developer, so tune in at 6 PM to check out what game insights have been prepared!

notes.title: Mona Chrome - the evil that’s black and white
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35537578/cb92835cad070420386e80a0c897021371948fe2.png[/img]

Oh no, all the color has been stripped from the lands by the evil [b]Mona Chrome[/b]! She stole the mysterious [b]Pretorian Crystals[/b] and used the anti-color laser placed on the top of her Mona Tower to turn the world black and white. She also turned the people into her lifeless army of slaves! Mona Chrome simply hates anything colorful, joyful, and bright, and her life mission is to keep all those things from the world of [b]TOGETHER[/b], forever. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121010/TOGETHER

The future looks quite grim, doesn’t it? Well, fortunately, not all the inhabitants of this world went under her control. A group of heroes not affected by the power of Mona’s laser beams is out on a mission to get her! They are using their weapons to smack the monochromatic members of Mona’s army on their heads, thus bringing the color back to them and rescuing them from under her control. [b]Heroes travel through four different worlds[/b] to find the scattered Pretorian Crystals, gain special abilities and superpowers and finally meet the Mona Chrome herself in the final battle.

Will they succeed in this mission and restore the colors to this world? Well, it’s up to you to play Together and see for yourself! 

[b]The TOGETHER demo will be out on the 1st of October![/b]

notes.title: Meet the Hero - Robin Food
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35537578/3b19a80cb3ac58bc922df2fd24e8defa29e2a3db.png[/img]

He is the first one on the [b]TOGETHER[/b]’s list of heroes, proudly sporting a mustache and a goatee. [b]Robin Food[/b] is the name and snacks are his game. No, Robin doesn’t look too happy, and that’s because he is always hungry. No matter how much junk food he puts in his mouth, he’s always craving for more. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121010/TOGETHER/

Choose Robin Food as your character in [b]TOGETHER[/b], and you will be jumping and smashing your enemies with a solid half-pound burger on a stick. That’s a weapon feared by most of the evil soldiers of Mona Chrome. If you think wielding a burger is a cool thing to do, wait until you have enough Pretorian Crystals to discover Robin Food’s special movement and special skill!

In TOGETHER, you can unlock plenty more characters to choose from, every one of them with their own weapons and skills.[b] The TOGETHER demo is coming to PC’s on the first of October![/b]

notes.title: TOGETHER Trailer + Demo announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35537578/11a693f028ace4da0e33f5fd43ae2c989345f809.png[/img]

[b]TOGETHER [/b]is a fantastic cooperative game, where you jump, skip, shoot and use your special abilities to go through various levels and defeat the evil [b]Mona Chrome[/b]! You can enjoy the multiplayer on one screen and even play together on one keyboard. It’s easy to pick up and enjoy by kids and adults alike. Our colorful platformer has been very well-received on Nintendo Switch, and now we are bringing it to [b]your PC![/b]  

Did you know that another [b]Steam Next Festival[/b] is starting soon, and we’re a part of it with our exclusive TOGETHER game demo? 

Oh yes, that is one celebration you don’t want to miss out on. The event begins on the [b]1st of October [/b]and will go on for an entire week. You will be able to download the TOGETHER demo and play it for as long as you like! If that’s not enough, we are preparing[b] live streams[/b] from the game with members of our time and a few special guests, which will run for the entire festival duration. We will also host [b]Q&A sessions[/b], where you will be able to ask us anything you like.

Here’s a brand new [b]TOGETHER trailer[/b] to give you a little taste of what’s to come:

[previewyoutube=6rME2mLY9r4;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re super happy we can be a part of the festive fun on Steam together with you guys, and we can’t wait for it to start. [b]See you soon! [/b]
